description: This file contains functions for JSON manipulation, network interface configuration, switch configuration, LED control, and system info setup, primarily used for device initialization and configuration in embedded Linux systems.

methods.name: json_select_array
methods.description: Selects a JSON array by key, adds array if not present.

methods.name: json_select_object
methods.description: Selects a JSON object by key, adds object if not present.

methods.name: ucidef_set_interface
methods.description: Configures a network interface with specified parameters.

methods.name: ucidef_set_board_id
methods.description: Sets the board ID in JSON configuration.

methods.name: ucidef_set_model_name
methods.description: Sets the model name in JSON configuration.

methods.name: ucidef_set_interface_lan
methods.description: Configures LAN interface with given name and protocol.

methods.name: ucidef_set_interface_wan
methods.description: Configures WAN interface with given name and protocol.

methods.name: ucidef_set_interfaces_lan_wan
methods.description: Configures both LAN and WAN interfaces.

methods.name: _ucidef_add_switch_port
methods.description: Adds a switch port configuration to JSON.

methods.name: ucidef_add_switch
methods.description: Adds a switch with specified ports and roles.

methods.name: ucidef_add_switch_port_attr
methods.description: Adds attributes to a switch port.

methods.name: ucidef_set_interface_macaddr
methods.description: Sets MAC address for a network interface.

methods.name: ucidef_set_led_ataport
methods.description: Sets LED trigger for ATA port.

methods.name: _ucidef_set_led_common
methods.description: Helper for setting common LED properties.

methods.name: ucidef_set_led_ide
methods.description: Sets LED trigger for IDE disk.

methods.name: _ucidef_set_led_timer
methods.description: Helper for setting LED timer properties.

methods.name: ucidef_set_led_usbhost
methods.description: Sets USB host trigger for LED.

methods.name: board_config_update
methods.description: Initializes or updates board configuration JSON.

methods.name: board_config_flush
methods.description: Saves current JSON configuration to file.
